name: Breakout Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as breakout.vc, the San Francisco science-and-technology seed firm founded in 2016 with managing partners Lindy Fishburne and Julia Moore (Pulse 2.0 Fund III article). Its portfolio page names Cytovale, Twelve, Noetik, Phantom Neuro and ZymoChem. Not Breakout Capital, not Breakthrough Energy Ventures, not Breakout Labs (Thiel Foundation).
